philosophy.scale: design at 2x target size, display down
philosophy.motion: small continuous motion; strong motion reserved for state changes
philosophy.state: every important state has a distinct shape, not only a color

rules: No two agent silhouettes may be interchangeable at small size.
Do not encode good/bad using color alone; pair color with shape and motion.
Keep icon geometry bold enough to survive a 32-44px UI display.
Use texture and tiny geometry as secondary detail, never as primary information.
Reserve animation spikes, glow and screen emphasis for player-caused or simulation-critical changes.
Scenario art should communicate the dominant failure mode before the player reads its label.
